/bin/zsh -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/csv-insights.XXXXXX)
printf '"'team,name,amount,notes\\nA,Alice,1.20,\"hello, world\"\\nB,Bob,2.30,\"line one\\nline two\"\\nA,Cara,3.30,ok\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/data.csv"
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --where team=A --output json
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --group-by team --sum amount --avg amount --output json
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --group-by team --sum amount --avg amount --output csv
printf '"'a,b\\n1\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/bad-width.csv"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/bad-width.csv" >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/error"; then exit 1; fi
rg -q '"'row 2 has 1 fields; expected 2' \""'$tmpdir/error"
printf '"'group,amount\\nX,\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/bad-number.csv"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/bad-number.csv" --group-by group --sum amount >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/error"; then exit 1; fi
rg -q "invalid numeric value at row 2, column '"'amount': blank\" \""'$tmpdir/error"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --sum amount >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/error"; then exit 1; fi
rg -q -- '"'--sum and --avg require --group-by' \""'$tmpdir/error"
rm -rf "$tmpdir"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/csv-insights-check.XXXXXX)
printf '"'group,amount,value\\nB,1.00,x\\nA,0.01,x\\nA,2.49,y\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/data.csv"
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --group-by group --sum amount --avg amount --output json > "$tmpdir/out"
rg -x '"'\\[{\"group\": \"A\", \"sum_amount\": \"2.5\", \"avg_amount\": \"1.25\"}, {\"group\": \"B\", \"sum_amount\": \"1\", \"avg_amount\": \"1\"}\\]' \""'$tmpdir/out"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --where missing=x >/dev/null 2> "$tmpdir/err"; then exit 1; fi

rg -q '"'malformed filter' \""'$tmpdir/err"
if python3 main.py "$tmpdir/data.csv" --group-by group --avg value >/dev/null 2> "$tmpdir/err"; then exit 1; fi
rg -q "invalid numeric value at row 2, column '"'value': 'x'\" \""'$tmpdir/err"
printf '"'a,a\\n1,2\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/duplicate.csv"

rm -rf "$tmpdir"
git status --short'

Implemented the dependency-free CSV Insights CLI in [main.py](/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/codex-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T223606Z/skill-state-v3/csv-insights/main.py) with filtering, Decimal aggregation, JSON/CSV output, and input validation. Added usage documentation in [README.md](/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/codex-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T223606Z/skill-state-v3/csv-insights/README.md).

Verified with `python3 -m py_compile main.py` plus end-to-end checks for aggregation, errors, and CSV validation.
